chunks.sanskrit: īśaḥ sarvasya jagataḥ prabhuḥ prīṇāti̍ viśva̠bhuk
ta̠nuvā̍ me sa̠ha nama̍ste astu̠ mā mā̍ higͫsīḥ
vayaḥ̍ supa̠rṇā upa̍sedu̠rindraṃ̍ pri̠ya me̍dhā̠ ṛṣa̍yo̠ nādha̍mānāḥ|

śi̠vena̍ me̠ santi̍ṣṭhasva syo̠nena̍ me̠ santi̍ṣṭhasva subhū̠tena̍ me̠ santi̍ṣṭhasva brahmavarca̠sena̍ me̠ santi̍ṣṭhasva ya̠jñasyarddhi̠ manu̠ santi̍ṣṭha̠ svopa̍ te yajña̠ nama̠ upa̍ te̠ nama̠ upa̍ te̠ namaḥ̍

sa̠tyaṃ paraṃ̠ para̍gͫ sa̠tyagͫ sa̠tyena̠ na su̍va̠rgāllo̠kāccya̍vante ka̠dāca̠na sa̠tāgͫ hi sa̠tyaṃ tasmā̎th sa̠tye ra̍mante̠, (1) tapa̠ iti̠ tapo̠ nānaśa̍nā̠t para̠ym̐yaddhi paraṃ̠ tapa̠stad dudha̍rrṣaṃ̠ tad durā̍dharṣaṃ̠ tasmā̠t tapa̍si ramante̠, (2) dama̠ iti̠ niya̍taṃ brahmacā̠riṇa̠stasmā̠d dame̍ ramante̠, (3) śama̠ ityara̍ṇye mu̠naya̠stasmā̠cchame̍ ramante, (4) dā̠namiti̠ sarvā̍ṇi bhū̠tāni̍ pra̠śagͫsa̍nti dā̠nānnāti̍ du̠ścaraṃ̠ tasmā̎d dā̠ne ra̍mante, (5) dha̠rma iti̠ dharme̍ṇa̠ sarva̍mi̠daṃ pari̍gṛhītaṃ dha̠rmānnāti̍du̠ṣkaraṃ̠ tasmā̎d dha̠rme ra̍mante, (6) pra̠jana̠ iti̠ bhūyā̍gͫsa̠stasmā̠d bhūyi̍ṣṭhāḥ̠ prajā̍yante̠ tasmā̠d bhūyi̍ṣṭhāḥ pra̠jana̍ne ramante̠, (7) 'gnaya̠ ityā̍ha̠ tasmā̍da̠gnaya̠ ādhā̍tavyā agniho̠tramityā̍ha̠ tasmā̍dagniho̠tre ra̍mante, (8) ya̠jña iti̍ ya̠jño hi de̠vā stasmā̎d ya̠jñe ra̍mante, (9) māna̠samiti̍ vi̠dvāgͫsa̠stasmā̎d vi̠dvāgͫsa̍ e̠va mā̍na̠se ra̍mante, (10) nyā̠sa iti̍ bra̠hmā bra̠hmā hi paraḥ̠ paro̍ hi bra̠hmā tāni̠ vā e̠tānyava̍rāṇi̠ parā̍gͫsi nyā̠sa e̠vātya̍recaya̠d ya e̠vavm̐vede̎tyupa̠niṣat||

prā̠jā̠pa̠tyo hāru̍ṇiḥ supa̠rṇeyaḥ̍ pra̠jāpa̍tiṃ pi̠tara̠mupa̍sasāra̠ kiṃ bha̍gava̠ntaḥ pa̍ra̠mavm̐va̍da̠ntīti̠ tasmai̠ pro̍vāca, (1) sa̠tyena̍ vā̠yurāvā̍ti sa̠tyenā̍di̠tyo ro̍cate di̠vi sa̠tyavm̐vā̠caḥ pra̍ti̠ṣṭhā sa̠tye sa̠rvaṃ prati̍ṣṭhitaṃ̠ tasmā̎th sa̠tyaṃ pa̍ra̠mavm̐vada̍nti̠, (2) tapa̍sā de̠vā de̠vatā̠magra̍ āya̠n tapa̠sarṣa̍yaḥ̠ suva̠ranva̍vinda̠n tapa̍sā sa̠patnā̠n praṇu̍dā̠mārā̍tī̠ stapa̍si sa̠rvaṃ prati̍ṣṭhitaṃ̠ tasmā̠t tapaḥ̍ para̠mavm̐vada̍nti̠, (3) dame̍na dā̠ntāḥ ki̠lbiṣa̍mavadhū̠nvanti̠ dame̍na brahmacā̠riṇaḥ̠ suva̍ragaccha̠n damo̍ bhū̠tānāṃ̎ durā̠dharṣaṃ̠ dame̍ sa̠rvaṃ prati̍ṣṭhitaṃ̠ tasmā̠d damaḥ̍ para̠mavm̐vada̍nti̠, (4) śame̍na śā̠ntāḥ śi̠vamā̠cara̍nti̠ śame̍na nā̠kaṃ mu̠nayo̠'nvavi̍nda̠n chamo̍ bhū̠tānāṃ̎ durā̠dharṣaṃ̠ chame̍ sa̠rvaṃ prati̍ṣṭhitaṃ̠ tasmā̠cchamaḥ̍ para̠mavm̐vada̍nti, (5) dā̠naym̐ya̠jñānā̠vm̐varū̍thaṃ̠ dakhṣi̍ṇā lo̠ke dā̠tāra̍gͫ sarva bhū̠tānyu̍pajī̠vanti̍ dā̠nenārā̍tī̠rapā̍nudanta dā̠nena̍ dviṣa̠nto mi̠trā bha̍vanti dā̠ne sa̠rvaṃ prati̍ṣṭhitaṃ̠ tasmā̎d dā̠naṃ pa̍ra̠mavm̐vada̍nti, (6) dha̠rmo viśva̍sya̠ jaga̍taḥ prati̠ṣṭhā lo̠ke dha̠rmiṣṭhaṃ̍ pra̠jā u̍pasa̠rpanti̍ dha̠rmeṇa̍ pā̠pama̍pa̠nuda̍ti dha̠rme sa̠rvaṃ prati̍ṣṭhitaṃ̠ tasmā̎d dha̠rmaṃ pa̍ra̠mavm̐vada̍nti, (7) pra̠jana̍na̠vm̐vai pra̍ti̠ṣṭhā lo̠ke sā̠dhu pra̠jāyā̎ sta̠ntuṃta̍nvā̠naḥ pi̍tṛ̠ṇā ma̍nṛ̠ṇo bhava̍ti̠ tade̍va ta̠syā anṛ̍ṇaṃ̠ tasmā̎t pra̠jana̍naṃ para̠mavm̐vada̍ntya̠, (8) gnayo̠ vai trayī̍ vi̠dyā de̍va̠yānaḥ̠ panthā̍ gārhapa̠tya ṛkpṛ̍thi̠vī ra̍thanta̠ra ma̍nvāhār ya̠paca̍na̠ym̐yaju̍ra̠ntari̍khṣavm̐vāmade̠vya mā̍hava̠nīyaḥ̠ sāma̍suva̠rgo lo̠ko bṛ̠hattasmā̍da̠gnīn pa̍ra̠mavm̐vada̍ntya, (9) gniho̠tragͫ sā̍yaṃ prā̠targṛ̠hāṇāṃ̠niṣkṛ̍tiḥ̠ svi̍ṣṭagͫ suhu̠taym̐ya̍jñakratū̠nāṃ prāya̍ṇagͫ suva̠rgasya̍ lo̠kasya̠ jyoti̠stasmā̍dagniho̠traṃ pa̍ra̠mavm̐vada̍nti, (10) ya̠jña iti̍ ya̠jñena̠ hi de̠vā divaṃ̍ ga̠tā ya̠jñenāsu̍rā̠napā̍nudanta ya̠jñena̍ dviṣa̠nto mi̠trā bha̍vanti ya̠jñe sa̠rvaṃ prati̍ṣṭhitaṃ̠ tasmā̎d ya̠jñaṃ pa̍ra̠mavm̐vada̍nti, (11) māna̠savm̐vai prā̍jāpa̠tyaṃ pa̠vitraṃ̍ māna̠sena̠ mana̍sā sā̠dhu pa̍śyati māna̠sā ṛṣa̍yaḥ pra̠jā a̍sṛjanta māna̠se sa̠rvaṃ prati̍ṣṭhitaṃ̠ tasmā̎n māna̠saṃ pa̍ra̠mavm̐vada̍nti, (12) nyā̠sa i̠tyāhu̍r manī̠ṣiṇo̎ bra̠hmāṇaṃ̍ bra̠hmā viśvaḥ̍ kata̠maḥ sva̍ya̠bhuṃḥ pra̠jāpa̍tiḥ savm̐vathsa̠ra iti̍, (13) savm̐vathsa̠ro̍ 'sāvā̍di̠tyo ya e̠ṣa ā̍di̠tye puru̍ṣaḥ̠ sa pa̍rame̠ṣṭhī brahmā̠tmā, (14) yābhi̍rādi̠tyastapa̍ti ra̠śmibhi̠stābhiḥ̍ pa̠rjanyo̍ varṣati pa̠rjanye̍nauṣadhivanaspa̠tayaḥ̠ prajā̍yanta oṣadhivanaspa̠tibhi̠rannaṃ̍ bhava̠tyanne̍na prā̠ṇāḥ prā̠ṇair balaṃ̠ bale̍na̠ tapa̠stapa̍sā śra̠ddhā śra̠ddhayā̍ me̠dhā me̠dhayā̍ manī̠ṣā ma̍nī̠ṣayā̠ mano̠ mana̍sā̠ śāntiḥ̠ śāntyā̍ ci̠ttaṃ ci̠ttena̠ smṛti̠g̠ͫͫ smṛtyā̠ smāra̠g̠ͫͫ smāre̍ṇa vi̠jñāna̍vm̐vi̠jñāne̍nā̠tmāna̍vm̐vedayati̠ tasmā̍da̠nnaṃ dada̠nth sarvā̎ṇye̠tāni̍ dadā̠tyannā̎t prā̠ṇā bha̍vanti bhū̠tānāṃ̎ prā̠ṇair mano̠ mana̍saśca vi̠jñāna̍vm̐vi̠jñānā̍dāna̠ndo bra̍hma yo̠niḥ, (15) sa vā e̠ṣa puru̍ṣaḥ pañca̠dhā pa̍ñcā̠tmā yena̠ sarva̍mi̠daṃ protaṃ̍ pṛthi̠vī cā̠ntari̍khṣaṃ ca̠ dyauśca̠ diśa̍ścāvāntaradi̠śāśca̠ sa vai sarva̍mi̠daṃ jaga̠thsa sa̠bhūta̍gͫ sa bha̠vyaṃ ji̍jñāsa klṛ̠pta ṛ̍ta̠jā rayi̍ṣṭhā śra̠ddhā sa̠tyo maha̍svān ta̠paso̠ pari̍ṣṭhā̠d, (vari̍ṣṭhā̠d) (16) jñātvā̍ tame̠vaṃ mana̍sā hṛ̠dā ca̠ bhūyo̍ na mṛ̠tyumupa̍yāhi vi̠dvān (17) tasmā̎nnyā̠same̠ṣāṃ tapa̍sāmatirikta̠māhu̍r, (18) vasura̠ṇvo̍ vi̠bhūra̍si prā̠ṇe tvamasi̍ sandhā̠tā brahma̍n tvamasi̍ viśva̠dhṛtte̍jo̠dā stvama̍sya̠gnira̍si varco̠dāstvama̍si̠ sūrya̍sya dyumno̠dā stvama̍si ca̠ndrama̍sa upayā̠magṛ̍hīto'si bra̠hmaṇe̎ tvā̠ mahasa̠, (19) omityā̠tmāna̍ym̐yuñjītai̠tadvai ma̍hopa̠niṣa̍daṃ de̠vānāṃ̠ guhya̠ym̐ya e̠vavm̐veda̍ bra̠hmaṇo̍ mahi̠māna̍māpnoti̠ tasmā̎d bra̠hmaṇo̍ mahi̠māna̍mityupa̠niṣat||

tasyai̠vavm̐vi̠duṣo̍ ya̠jñasyā̠tmā yaja̍mānaḥśra̠dhdāpatnī̠ śarī̍rami̠ddhmamuro̠ vedi̠rlomā̍ni ba̠ra̠hirve̠daḥśikhā̠ hṛda̍ya̠ym̐yūpaḥ̠ kāma̠ ājyaṃ̍ ma̠nyuḥ pa̠śustapo̠'gnirdamaḥ̍ śamayi̠tā dakhṣi̍ṇā̠vāgghotā̎ prā̠ṇa u̍dga̠tā cakhṣu̍radhva̠ryurmano̠ brahmā̠ śrotra̍ma̠gnī dyāva̠ddhriya̍te̠ sā dī̠khṣā yadaśñā̍ti̠ tadhdavi̠ryatpiba̍ti̠ tada̍sya somapā̠naym̐yadrama̍te̠ tadu̍pa̠sado̠ yath saṃ̠cara̍tyupa̠viśa̍tyu̠ttiṣṭha̍te ca̠ sapra̍va̠rgyo̍ yanmukhaṃ̠ tadā̍hava̠nīyo̠ yā vyāhṛ̍tirāhu̠tiryada̍sya vi̠jñānaṃ̠ tajju̠hoti̠ yathsā̠yaṃ prā̠tara̍tti̠ tathsa̠midha̠ym̐yatprā̠tar ma̠ddhyandi̍nagͫ sā̠yaṃ ca̠ tāni̠ sava̍nāni̠ ye a̍horā̠tre te da̍rśapūrṇamā̠sau ye̎'rddhamā̠sāśca̠ māsā̎śca̠ te cā̍turmā̠syāni̠ ya ṛ̠tava̠ste pa̍śuba̠ndhā ye sa̍vm̐vathsa̠rāśca̍ parivathsa̠rāśca̠ te'ha̍rga̠ṇāḥ sa̍rva veda̠savm̐vā e̠tath sa̠traym̐yanmara̍ṇaṃ̠ tada̍va̠bhṛtha̍ e̠tadvai ja̍rāmaryamagniho̠tragͫ sa̠traym̐ya e̠vavm̐vi̠dvānu̍da̠gaya̍ne pra̠mīya̍te de̠vānā̍me̠va ma̍hi̠mānaṃ̍ ga̠tvā''di̠tyasya̠ sāyu̍jyaṃ gaccha̠tyatha̠ yo da̍khṣi̠ṇe pra̠mīya̍te pitṛ̠ṇāme̠va ma̍hi̠mānaṃ̍ ga̠tvā ca̠ndrama̍saḥ̠ sāyu̍jyagͫ salo̠katā̍māpnotye̠tau vai sū̎ryā candra̠maso̎rmahi̠mānau̎ brāhma̠ṇo vi̠dvāna̠bhija̍yati̠ tasmā̎d bra̠hmaṇo̍ mahi̠māna̍māpnoti̠ tasmā̎d bra̠hmaṇo̍ mahi̠māna̍mityupa̠niṣat
